description: The outbound-call rows of the Ever Platform contract each optional module makes in this release (see outbound-calls.mjs). A row added here must be made by the module, listed in its README's request table and exercised by the egress audit's every_trigger run.

8.trigger: while connected: at connect and at each link, with each heartbeat, on an entitlement notice on the event feed, on demand (Refresh, at most 6 an hour)
8.cadence: with the heartbeat (every 24 h); on a notice; on demand
